P2P Chat

Connect. Relay. Chat.

Private messaging with no internet, no mobile data and no server. P2P Chat turns nearby Android phones into a Bluetooth mesh — your message hops from phone to phone until it reaches the person it is meant for, end-to-end encrypted the whole way.

How the mesh works

Bluetooth alone does not relay messages — P2P Chat implements real multi-hop forwarding. If A and D are too far apart for a direct connection, B and C carry the encrypted envelope between them. Relays can forward a message but can never read it.

A
→
B
→
C
→
D

A sends → B relays → C relays → D receives → D's signed acknowledgement travels back, and only then does A's message show Delivered.

True multi-hop relay

Store-and-forward routing with hop limits, duplicate suppression and loop protection. Messages wait in a persistent queue until a route appears.

End-to-end encrypted

Ed25519 identities and X25519 + AES-256-GCM encryption. Every envelope is signed; relays see ciphertext only — never your words.

Honest delivery states

Queued, Relayed and Delivered mean exactly what they say. A message is marked delivered only when the recipient's acknowledgement returns — never just because a relay took it.

Works fully offline

No SIM, no Wi-Fi, no account, no server. Useful in remote areas, disasters, festivals, campuses and anywhere networks fail or are watched.

Background relay

A battery-aware foreground service keeps your phone relaying for others with duty-cycled Bluetooth scanning — you control it from settings.

Your identity stays yours

Keys are generated on your phone and stored encrypted in the Android Keystore. There is no cloud copy — and no company in the middle.

Install in 3 steps

1. Download the APK

Tap the download button on this page and save P2PChat-v1.0.0.apk to your phone.

2. Allow the install

Open the file and, if Android asks, allow installs from your browser or Files app. This is a direct (non-Play-Store) test build.

3. Grant Bluetooth & chat

Open P2P Chat, pick a display name, allow the Bluetooth permissions, and turn Bluetooth on when the system prompt appears. Nearby P2P Chat phones appear automatically.
